build.energy_regen_target: 120-130% (Prydwen recommends 120-125% in a Zhezhi + Shorekeeper team)
build.fast_path: Fast path: Abyss Surges + 5-piece Frosty Resolve in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout with Sentry Construct in the main slot. Stack Crit and ATK% with around 120-130% Energy Regen; he needs buffers and full field time for his aerial Striding Lion window.

ranked_weapons.name: Abyss Surges
ranked_weapons.note: His signature; Energy Regen plus cycling Basic and Resonance Skill DMG bonuses that match his rotation. Game8 calls it 'by far' his best.

ranked_weapons.name: Hollow Mirage
ranked_weapons.note: Game8's second pick; ATK and DEF stacks after casting Liberation.

ranked_weapons.name: Stonard
ranked_weapons.note: Battle-pass option; +18% Liberation DMG for 15s after Resonance Skill.

ranked_weapons.name: Marcato
ranked_weapons.note: Energy Regen substat and 8 Concerto Energy on Resonance Skill to smooth out rotations.

ranked_weapons.name: Gauntlets of Night
ranked_weapons.note: Free 3-star; ATK buff on Intro Skill.

profile.role_note: Aerial Glacio hypercarry; most of his damage happens inside the Striding Lion window.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: A fun aerial Glacio hypercarry whose damage trails modern 5-stars — build him for the playstyle, not for chasing the meta.

members.name: Lingyang
members.note: Aerial hypercarry; damage concentrated in the Striding Lion window.

members.name: Zhezhi
members.note: Glacio sub-DPS; buffs Lingyang via Outro.

teams.name: Lingyang + Zhezhi + Shorekeeper
teams.rotation: Shorekeeper fires her Liberation, Zhezhi runs her full rotation and Outros into Lingyang, who enters with Intro + Liberation and unloads his aerial Striding Lion combo.

members.name: Sanhua
members.note: Free-to-play sub-DPS; Outro buffs Basic Attack DMG.

members.name: Verina
members.note: Heals and deepens team damage; documented support replacement on Game8's team page.

teams.name: Lingyang + Sanhua + Verina
teams.rotation: Sanhua builds Concerto and Outros into Lingyang for the Basic Attack buff, Verina sustains, then Lingyang takes his Striding Lion window.
